explanation: Oil is one of the commodities the fourth buyer came for, and the company that produces it is the one the monopoly of 1953 created: Chinese investment in Brazil has gone into financing oil exploration as well as repairing railways, and Petrobras is what there was to invest in. `enabled` and not `caused`: the boom was made by demand from emerging markets and above all from China, and what the state monopoly supplied was a Brazilian counterparty large enough to sell at that scale.
